For thinking, writing, strategy, research, and complex work, I keep coming back to Claude and ChatGPT. Codex is becoming a bigger part of how I handle technical work and build faster. For creation, Canva is still one of the easiest ways to turn an idea into something useful. Descript and CapCut handle a lot of the video work. Midjourney is still useful when I want more stylized visuals. For organization, I keep things simple. Google Drive, Slack, and a small number of tools I already use every day.
